<?php
namespace App\Services;

use App\Core\Database;

/**
 * Service = business logica (import), los van HTTP.
 *
 * In controllers moet je liefst geen CSV parsing doen.
 * Controllers: input lezen -> service aanroepen -> response sturen.
 */
class TikTokCsvImporter {
    private $db;
    public function __construct(Database $db) {
        $this->db = $db;
    }

    private function normalizeHeader(array $header): array {
        $out = [];
        foreach ($header as $h) {
            $k = strtolower(trim((string)$h));
            $k = preg_replace('/\s+/', '_', $k);
            $out[] = $k;
        }
        return $out;
    }

    private function v($x): ?string {
        if ($x === null) return null;
        $x = trim((string)$x);
        return $x === '' ? null : $x;
    }

    /**
     * Verwacht $_FILES['file'] input.
     * Doet:
     * - header detectie
     * - upsert in posts
     * - snapshot insert in metrics_history
     * - log in import_history
     */
    public function import(array $file): array {
        if (($file['error'] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE) !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
            return ['processed' => 0, 'skipped' => 0, 'error' => 'Upload mislukt'];
        }

        $tmp = $file['tmp_name'];
        $processed = 0;
        $skipped = 0;

        $conn = $this->db->conn();
        $conn->begin_transaction();

        try {
            $postsUpsert = $conn->prepare("
                INSERT INTO posts (platform, platform_post_id, post_url, caption, posted_date, posted_time, views, likes, comments, shares)
                VALUES ('tiktok', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
                    post_url = VALUES(post_url),
                    caption = VALUES(caption),
                    posted_date = VALUES(posted_date),
                    posted_time = VALUES(posted_time),
                    views = VALUES(views),
                    likes = VALUES(likes),
                    comments = VALUES(comments),
                    shares = VALUES(shares)
            ");

            $getPostId = $conn->prepare("SELECT id FROM posts WHERE platform='tiktok' AND platform_post_id=? LIMIT 1");
            $mhInsert = $conn->prepare("
                INSERT INTO metrics_history (post_id, views, likes, comments, shares, saves, snapshot_date)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            ");

            if (($fh = fopen($tmp, 'r')) === false) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('Kan CSV niet openen');
            }

            $header = fgetcsv($fh);
            if (!$header) throw new \RuntimeException('Lege CSV');
            $header = $this->normalizeHeader($header);

            while (($row = fgetcsv($fh)) !== false) {
                $rec = array_combine($header, $row);

                // Flexibele keys: pas aan naar je exacte export indien nodig
                $ppid = $this->v($rec['post_id'] ?? $rec['video_id'] ?? $rec['id'] ?? null);
                if (!$ppid) { $skipped++; continue; }

                $caption = $this->v($rec['caption'] ?? $rec['title'] ?? null);
                $url = $this->v($rec['url'] ?? $rec['link'] ?? null);
                $date = $this->v($rec['posted_date'] ?? $rec['date'] ?? $rec['published_date'] ?? null);
                $time = $this->v($rec['posted_time'] ?? $rec['time'] ?? null);

                $views = (int)($rec['views'] ?? $rec['play_count'] ?? 0);
                $likes = (int)($rec['likes'] ?? $rec['like_count'] ?? 0);
                $comments = (int)($rec['comments'] ?? $rec['comment_count'] ?? 0);
                $shares = (int)($rec['shares'] ?? $rec['share_count'] ?? 0);
                $saves = (int)($rec['saves'] ?? $rec['save_count'] ?? 0);
                $snapshot = $this->v($rec['snapshot_date'] ?? date('Y-m-d'));

                // posts upsert
                $postsUpsert->bind_param("sssssiiii", $ppid, $url, $caption, $date, $time, $views, $likes, $comments, $shares);
                $postsUpsert->execute();

                // find post_id
                $getPostId->bind_param("s", $ppid);
                $getPostId->execute();
                $res = $getPostId->get_result();
                $pidRow = $res ? $res->fetch_assoc() : null;
                $pid = $pidRow ? (int)$pidRow['id'] : 0;

                if ($pid) {
                    $mhInsert->bind_param("iiiiiis", $pid, $views, $likes, $comments, $shares, $saves, $snapshot);
                    $mhInsert->execute();
                }

                $processed++;
            }

            fclose($fh);

            // import_history
            $fn = $file['name'] ?? 'upload.csv';
            $imp = $conn->prepare("
                INSERT INTO import_history (filename, platform, import_type, rows_imported, rows_skipped, imported_at)
                VALUES (?, 'tiktok', 'csv', ?, ?, NOW())
            ");
            $imp->bind_param("sii", $fn, $processed, $skipped);
            $imp->execute();

            $conn->commit();
            return ['processed' => $processed, 'skipped' => $skipped];
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $conn->rollback();
            return ['processed' => $processed, 'skipped' => $skipped, 'error' => $e->getMessage()];
        }
    }
}

<?php
namespace App\Services;

use App\Core\Database;

/**
 * TikTok CSV Importer - optimized with batch processing pattern.
 *
 * Service = business logica (import), los van HTTP.
 * In controllers moet je liefst geen CSV parsing doen.
 * Controllers: input lezen -> service aanroepen -> response sturen.
 *
 * Uses batch processing pattern for improved performance:
 * - Collects rows into batches of BATCH_SIZE (default: 100)
 * - Uses multi-row INSERT for posts and metrics_history tables
 * - Batch lookup for post IDs using tuple IN syntax
 * - For large files (>10k rows), commits every CHUNK_COMMIT_SIZE rows
 */
class TikTokCsvImporter {
    /**
     * Number of rows to collect before executing a batch insert.
     * Balances memory usage vs. database round-trips.
     */
    private const BATCH_SIZE = 100;

    /**
     * Number of rows to process before committing a chunk.
     * For very large files (10k+ rows), commits are made every CHUNK_COMMIT_SIZE
     * rows to prevent transaction timeouts and reduce memory pressure.
     */
    private const CHUNK_COMMIT_SIZE = 5000;

    private $db;

    public function __construct(Database $db) {
        $this->db = $db;
    }

    private function normalizeHeader(array $header): array {
        $out = [];
        foreach ($header as $i => $h) {
            $k = (string)$h;
            // Strip BOM from first column
            if ($i === 0) {
                $k = preg_replace('/^\xEF\xBB\xBF/', '', $k);
            }
            $k = strtolower(trim($k));
            $k = preg_replace('/\s+/', '_', $k);
            $out[] = $k;
        }
        return $out;
    }

    private function v($x): ?string {
        if ($x === null) return null;
        $x = trim((string)$x);
        return $x === '' ? null : $x;
    }

    private function toInt($x): int {
        if ($x === null) return 0;
        $x = trim((string)$x);
        $x = str_replace(',', '.', $x);
        return (int)floatval($x);
    }

    /**
     * Build multi-row INSERT SQL with ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE.
     *
     * Constructs efficient batch INSERT statements for inserting multiple rows
     * at once, reducing database round-trips significantly.
     *
     * @param string $table Table name
     * @param array $columns Column names
     * @param array $rows Array of rows, each row is an associative array with column values
     * @param array $updateColumns Columns to update on duplicate key (uses VALUES() syntax)
     * @param array $updateExpressions Custom update expressions (e.g., ['views' => 'GREATEST(views, VALUES(views))'])
     * @return array{sql: string, types: string, params: array} SQL query, bind types, and flat params array
     */
    private function buildMultiRowInsertSql(
        string $table,
        array $columns,
        array $rows,
        array $updateColumns = [],
        array $updateExpressions = []
    ): array {
        if (empty($rows) || empty($columns)) {
            return ['sql' => '', 'types' => '', 'params' => []];
        }

        // Build column list
        $columnList = implode(', ', $columns);

        // Build placeholder row: (?, ?, ?, ...)
        $placeholderRow = '(' . implode(', ', array_fill(0, count($columns), '?')) . ')';

        // Build all value rows
        $valuePlaceholders = [];
        $params = [];
        $types = '';

        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $valuePlaceholders[] = $placeholderRow;

            // Add each column value in order
            foreach ($columns as $col) {
                $value = $row[$col] ?? null;
                $params[] = $value;

                // Determine type for mysqli bind
                if ($value === null) {
                    $types .= 's'; // null is handled as string
                } elseif (is_int($value)) {
                    $types .= 'i';
                } elseif (is_float($value)) {
                    $types .= 'd';
                } else {
                    $types .= 's';
                }
            }
        }

        // Build INSERT statement
        $sql = "INSERT INTO {$table} ({$columnList}) VALUES " . implode(', ', $valuePlaceholders);

        // Build ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE clause
        $updateParts = [];

        // Simple column updates using VALUES()
        foreach ($updateColumns as $col) {
            $updateParts[] = "{$col} = VALUES({$col})";
        }

        // Custom expressions (e.g., GREATEST, COALESCE)
        foreach ($updateExpressions as $col => $expr) {
            $updateParts[] = "{$col} = {$expr}";
        }

        if (!empty($updateParts)) {
            $sql .= " ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE " . implode(', ', $updateParts);
        }

        return [
            'sql' => $sql,
            'types' => $types,
            'params' => $params
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Resolve post IDs in batch using tuple IN syntax.
     *
     * Efficiently looks up multiple post IDs in a single query using:
     * WHERE (platform, platform_post_id) IN ((?, ?), (?, ?), ...)
     *
     * @param \mysqli $conn Database connection
     * @param array $mappedRows Array of mapped rows with 'platform_post_id' key
     * @return array Associative array mapping "tiktok|platform_post_id" => post_id (int)
     */
    private function resolvePostIdsBatch(\mysqli $conn, array $mappedRows): array {
        if (empty($mappedRows)) {
            return [];
        }

        // Build tuple placeholders: (?, ?), (?, ?), ...
        $tuplePlaceholders = [];
        $params = [];
        $types = '';

        foreach ($mappedRows as $mapped) {
            $tuplePlaceholders[] = '(?, ?)';
            $params[] = 'tiktok';
            $params[] = $mapped['platform_post_id'];
            $types .= 'ss';
        }

        // Build query with tuple IN syntax
        $sql = "SELECT id, platform, platform_post_id FROM posts WHERE (platform, platform_post_id) IN ("
             . implode(', ', $tuplePlaceholders) . ")";

        $postIdMap = [];

        $stmt = $conn->prepare($sql);
        if ($stmt) {
            if (!empty($params)) {
                $stmt->bind_param($types, ...$params);
            }
            $stmt->execute();
            $result = $stmt->get_result();
            while ($row = $result->fetch_assoc()) {
                $key = $row['platform'] . '|' . $row['platform_post_id'];
                $postIdMap[$key] = (int)$row['id'];
            }
            $stmt->close();
        }

        return $postIdMap;
    }

    /**
     * Insert posts in batch using multi-row INSERT with ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE.
     *
     * Efficiently inserts multiple posts at once, reducing database round-trips.
     *
     * @param \mysqli $conn Database connection
     * @param array $mappedRows Array of mapped rows from mapTikTokRow()
     * @return int Number of rows affected (inserted or updated)
     */
    private function insertPostsBatch(\mysqli $conn, array $mappedRows): int {
        if (empty($mappedRows)) {
            return 0;
        }

        // Define columns for posts table insert (TikTok-specific subset)
        $postColumns = [
            'platform', 'platform_post_id', 'post_url', 'caption',
            'posted_date', 'posted_time', 'views', 'likes', 'comments', 'shares'
        ];

        // Prepare post rows for batch insert
        $postRows = [];
        foreach ($mappedRows as $mapped) {
            $postRows[] = [
                'platform' => 'tiktok',
                'platform_post_id' => $mapped['platform_post_id'],
                'post_url' => $mapped['post_url'],
                'caption' => $mapped['caption'],
                'posted_date' => $mapped['posted_date'],
                'posted_time' => $mapped['posted_time'],
                'views' => $mapped['views'],
                'likes' => $mapped['likes'],
                'comments' => $mapped['comments'],
                'shares' => $mapped['shares']
            ];
        }

        // Columns to update with VALUES() on duplicate
        $updateColumns = [
            'post_url', 'caption', 'posted_date', 'posted_time'
        ];

        // Use VALUES() for metrics - simple update (TikTok importer behavior)
        $updateExpressions = [
            'views' => 'VALUES(views)',
            'likes' => 'VALUES(likes)',
            'comments' => 'VALUES(comments)',
            'shares' => 'VALUES(shares)'
        ];

        // Build multi-row INSERT with ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
        $insertData = $this->buildMultiRowInsertSql(
            'posts',
            $postColumns,
            $postRows,
            $updateColumns,
            $updateExpressions
        );

        if (empty($insertData['sql'])) {
            return 0;
        }

        $affectedRows = 0;
        $stmt = $conn->prepare($insertData['sql']);
        if ($stmt) {
            if (!empty($insertData['params'])) {
                $stmt->bind_param($insertData['types'], ...$insertData['params']);
            }
            $stmt->execute();
            $affectedRows = $stmt->affected_rows;
            $stmt->close();
        }

        return $affectedRows;
    }

    /**
     * Insert metrics history in batch using multi-row INSERT.
     *
     * Efficiently inserts multiple metrics snapshots at once, reducing database round-trips.
     *
     * @param \mysqli $conn Database connection
     * @param array $metricsRows Array of metrics data with post_id, views, likes, etc.
     * @return int Number of rows inserted
     */
    private function insertMetricsHistoryBatch(\mysqli $conn, array $metricsRows): int {
        if (empty($metricsRows)) {
            return 0;
        }

        // Define columns for metrics_history table insert
        $metricsColumns = [
            'post_id', 'views', 'likes', 'comments', 'shares', 'saves', 'snapshot_date'
        ];

        // Prepare metrics rows with proper column mapping
        $preparedRows = [];
        foreach ($metricsRows as $row) {
            $preparedRows[] = [
                'post_id' => (int)($row['post_id'] ?? 0),
                'views' => (int)($row['views'] ?? 0),
                'likes' => (int)($row['likes'] ?? 0),
                'comments' => (int)($row['comments'] ?? 0),
                'shares' => (int)($row['shares'] ?? 0),
                'saves' => (int)($row['saves'] ?? 0),
                'snapshot_date' => $row['snapshot_date'] ?? date('Y-m-d')
            ];
        }

        // Build multi-row INSERT (no ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE - metrics history is append-only)
        $insertData = $this->buildMultiRowInsertSql(
            'metrics_history',
            $metricsColumns,
            $preparedRows
        );

        if (empty($insertData['sql'])) {
            return 0;
        }

        $affectedRows = 0;
        $stmt = $conn->prepare($insertData['sql']);
        if ($stmt) {
            if (!empty($insertData['params'])) {
                $stmt->bind_param($insertData['types'], ...$insertData['params']);
            }
            $stmt->execute();
            $affectedRows = $stmt->affected_rows;
            $stmt->close();
        }

        return $affectedRows;
    }

    /**
     * Map TikTok CSV row to standard format
     *
     * @param array $rec Associative array from CSV row
     * @return array|null Mapped row or null if invalid
     */
    private function mapTikTokRow(array $rec): ?array {
        // Flexibele keys: pas aan naar je exacte export indien nodig
        $post_id = $this->v($rec['post_id'] ?? $rec['video_id'] ?? $rec['id'] ?? null);
        if (!$post_id) return null;

        $caption = $this->v($rec['caption'] ?? $rec['title'] ?? null);
        $url = $this->v($rec['url'] ?? $rec['link'] ?? null);
        $date = $this->v($rec['posted_date'] ?? $rec['date'] ?? $rec['published_date'] ?? null);
        $time = $this->v($rec['posted_time'] ?? $rec['time'] ?? null);

        $views = $this->toInt($rec['views'] ?? $rec['play_count'] ?? 0);
        $likes = $this->toInt($rec['likes'] ?? $rec['like_count'] ?? 0);
        $comments = $this->toInt($rec['comments'] ?? $rec['comment_count'] ?? 0);
        $shares = $this->toInt($rec['shares'] ?? $rec['share_count'] ?? 0);
        $saves = $this->toInt($rec['saves'] ?? $rec['save_count'] ?? 0);
        $snapshot = $this->v($rec['snapshot_date'] ?? date('Y-m-d'));

        return [
            'platform_post_id' => $post_id,
            'post_url' => $url,
            'caption' => $caption,
            'posted_date' => $date,
            'posted_time' => $time,
            'views' => $views,
            'likes' => $likes,
            'comments' => $comments,
            'shares' => $shares,
            'saves' => $saves,
            'snapshot_date' => $snapshot
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Import a batch of mapped rows - inserts posts, resolves IDs, inserts metrics.
     *
     * This method optimizes database operations by:
     * - Using multi-row INSERT for posts table
     * - Resolving all post IDs in a single query
     * - Using multi-row INSERT for metrics_history
     *
     * @param \mysqli $conn Database connection
     * @param array $batch Array of mapped rows from mapTikTokRow()
     * @return array{processed: int, skipped: int} Count of processed and skipped rows
     */
    private function importBatch(\mysqli $conn, array $batch): array {
        if (empty($batch)) {
            return ['processed' => 0, 'skipped' => 0];
        }

        $processed = 0;

        // === Step 1: Batch INSERT posts using dedicated method ===
        $this->insertPostsBatch($conn, $batch);

        // === Step 2: Resolve post IDs in bulk using optimized tuple IN syntax ===
        $postIdMap = $this->resolvePostIdsBatch($conn, $batch);

        // === Step 3: Build metrics rows for batch INSERT ===
        $metricsRows = [];

        foreach ($batch as $mapped) {
            $key = 'tiktok|' . $mapped['platform_post_id'];
            $postId = $postIdMap[$key] ?? null;

            if ($postId) {
                $metricsRows[] = [
                    'post_id' => $postId,
                    'views' => $mapped['views'],
                    'likes' => $mapped['likes'],
                    'comments' => $mapped['comments'],
                    'shares' => $mapped['shares'],
                    'saves' => $mapped['saves'],
                    'snapshot_date' => $mapped['snapshot_date']
                ];

                $processed++;
            }
        }

        // Insert metrics history in batch using dedicated method
        $this->insertMetricsHistoryBatch($conn, $metricsRows);

        return ['processed' => $processed, 'skipped' => count($batch) - $processed];
    }

    /**
     * Verwacht $_FILES['file'] input.
     * Doet:
     * - header detectie
     * - upsert in posts (batch)
     * - snapshot insert in metrics_history (batch)
     * - log in import_history
     *
     * Uses batch processing pattern for improved performance:
     * - Collects rows into batches of BATCH_SIZE (default: 100)
     * - Calls importBatch() when batch is full
     * - Processes remaining rows at end of file
     * - For large files (>10k rows), commits every CHUNK_COMMIT_SIZE rows
     */
    public function import(array $file): array {
        if (($file['error'] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE) !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
            return ['processed' => 0, 'skipped' => 0, 'error' => 'Upload mislukt'];
        }

        $tmp = $file['tmp_name'];
        $processed = 0;
        $skipped = 0;

        $conn = $this->db->conn();

        // Estimate row count for large file detection (>10k rows threshold)
        // Uses file size / avg row size heuristic to avoid full file scan
        $fileSize = filesize($tmp);
        $isLargeFile = $fileSize > 500000; // ~500KB, roughly 10k rows at 50 bytes/row avg

        $conn->begin_transaction();

        // Track rows processed since last chunk commit (for large files)
        $chunkRowsProcessed = 0;

        try {
            if (($fh = fopen($tmp, 'r')) === false) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('Kan CSV niet openen');
            }

            $header = fgetcsv($fh);
            if (!$header) throw new \RuntimeException('Lege CSV');
            $header = $this->normalizeHeader($header);

            // Batch processing - uses class constants for configuration
            $batch = [];

            // Process rows - collect into batches
            while (($row = fgetcsv($fh)) !== false) {
                if (count($row) !== count($header)) {
                    $skipped++;
                    continue;
                }

                $rec = array_combine($header, $row);

                // Map row to standard format
                $mapped = $this->mapTikTokRow($rec);

                if (!$mapped) {
                    $skipped++;
                    continue;
                }

                // Add to batch
                $batch[] = $mapped;

                // Process batch when full
                if (count($batch) >= self::BATCH_SIZE) {
                    $result = $this->importBatch($conn, $batch);
                    $processed += $result['processed'];
                    $skipped += $result['skipped'];
                    $chunkRowsProcessed += count($batch);
                    $batch = []; // Reset batch

                    // Chunked transaction commits for large files
                    // Commit and restart transaction every CHUNK_COMMIT_SIZE rows
                    // to prevent transaction timeouts and reduce memory pressure
                    if ($isLargeFile && $chunkRowsProcessed >= self::CHUNK_COMMIT_SIZE) {
                        $conn->commit();
                        $conn->begin_transaction();
                        $chunkRowsProcessed = 0;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Process remaining rows in the final batch
            if (!empty($batch)) {
                $result = $this->importBatch($conn, $batch);
                $processed += $result['processed'];
                $skipped += $result['skipped'];
            }

            fclose($fh);

            // import_history
            $fn = $file['name'] ?? 'upload.csv';
            $imp = $conn->prepare("
                INSERT INTO import_history (filename, platform, import_type, rows_imported, rows_skipped, imported_at)
                VALUES (?, 'tiktok', 'csv', ?, ?, NOW())
            ");
            $imp->bind_param("sii", $fn, $processed, $skipped);
            $imp->execute();

            $conn->commit();
            return ['processed' => $processed, 'skipped' => $skipped];
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $conn->rollback();
            return ['processed' => $processed, 'skipped' => $skipped, 'error' => $e->getMessage()];
        }
    }
}
